consent.title: Before capturing
consent.body: You are responsible for following your organization's policies and for informing participants and obtaining their consent where applicable. Capture only starts after you confirm.

permissionHelp.title: How to grant the permission
permissionHelp.generic: Open the system privacy settings and allow Dev Copilot to use the microphone. Then start the capture again.

macos.microphone: Open System Settings › Privacy & Security › Microphone and turn on Dev Copilot. Then start the capture again.
macos.system: Open System Settings › Privacy & Security and allow system audio recording for Dev Copilot.

windows.microphone: Open Settings › Privacy & security › Microphone, turn on microphone access and allow desktop apps. Then start the capture again.
windows.system: System audio capture on Windows needs no separate permission; check that the output device is active.

linux.microphone: Check your sound settings (PipeWire/PulseAudio) that the microphone is not muted and the app can access it. In sandboxed installs (Flatpak/Snap), grant the microphone permission. Then start the capture again.
linux.system: Check your sound settings (PipeWire/PulseAudio) that a monitor source is available.
